propositions: The lifespan shutdown drain waits only on queue.join() and misses in-flight reconciler reviews, causing them to be cancelled within ~10s instead of being protected by the 1200s shutdown_drain_seconds budget.

A reconciler review started via reconcile_once awaits review_and_vote inline outside the webhook queue, so when the queue empties the drain completes immediately and the reconcile_loop task is cancelled mid-review.
Any container stop outside autodeploy's health-check defer (manual docker compose restart, systemd stop, rollback) kills a reconciler review with no drain protection.

The fix implements cooperative request_stop() signaling plus a gated wait on voter.in_flight_reviews() within the shared shutdown_drain_seconds budget, preventing new reviews from starting during shutdown while draining existing ones.
The stop flag must be cleared after shutdown completes to prevent outliving the lifespan and causing subsequent reconcile_once calls to silently review nothing.
The cursor low-water-mark invariant requires held_back recording of candidates skipped during shutdown break, preventing unreachable gaps when the cursor advances past unevaluated events.
